    out:    data: int[]
  hidden
    in:     data: int[] <- load
    out:    hidden: int
  off

    out:    off: int
  show
    in:     hidden: int <- hidden

  hidden -> load [data]
  off -> hidden [hidden]
  show -> hidden [hidden]

  load: hidden, off, show
  hidden: off, show
